title: Polygraph question about loyalty to a non-human faction

tellings.quote: What I was told is that there was a additional question or two added to that sort of screening polygraph which is uh have you had any uh uh relationships with I haven't talked about or um loyalty to any non-human faction.

plain: Between about 2020 and 2022, people screened for the UAP Task Force, a Pentagon group set up to study unidentified flying objects, were asked an extra lie-detector question or two: had they had any relationships with, or loyalty to, "any non-human faction." Matthew Pines, a national security analyst, tells Michels this as something he was told. If true, it would mean officials took seriously the idea that people might be loyal to non-human beings.
